Outcome
Provide the minimum real theme needed for the early docked slice.

Owned scope
meridian-theme source/resources; initial control fixture; appearance lifecycle tests

Prerequisites
A2

Acceptance criteria
- [x] Compile deliberate AtlantaFX-derived user-agent resources for both appearances and densities; preserve a small reviewable upstream delta rather than a Modena-overlay production path.
- [x] Use the pinned AtlantaFX Theme/ThemeManager facilities; appearance, density, text scale and motion have one application preference source with explicit apply/dispose lifecycle.
- [x] Buttons, labels, text fields, basic table, menu and dialog render default/hover/pressed/focused/selected/disabled/invalid states without JavaFX CSS parser warnings.
- [x] Switching appearance reaches registered existing/new scenes without duplicate stylesheet entries or listeners; missing optional appearance preferences have documented defaults.
- [x] A small Java caller compiles and invokes the theme API; runtime theme JAR does not pull in ScalaDock or mandatory ScalaFX.

Required evidence
Native smoke captures in four variants, computed-style assertions, lifecycle/disposal tests and Java API compilation.

Completion rule
Record exact candidate/revisions, commands and exit status, retained evidence paths, and applicable limitations. No unrun checks or browser-only captures establish native correctness. Keep provider/app ownership in its own tracker. Implementers reserve exact paths before editing; shared source files have one writer. Use review until the stated reviewer/gate accepts.

Plan
PLAN.md — acceptance backlog code A3. Mote is authoritative for status and dependencies.

Local acceptance
2026-10-14: docs/evidence/a3/README.md, verification.json and source-manifest.json. Source candidate b0fa075adaf1d3704de887df93345f3ce59d7e641be157275abd2a46d7a6da35 (123 hashes); packaged theme JAR 8975ca80efa03b2a3e7c70f5c76a6010dcb8e664e50ad4f9ae1235581d924f3d. Four compiled themes; final clean build/native and independent Java consumer exit0; 245 native assertions, 12 inspected captures, 28 Python checks, A2 contrast224+12 exemptions preserved. CI configured but unrun hosted. Scope remains initial macOS controls; dock/scientific/a11y/platform qualification and publication retain later gates.
